text: Who developed the Java programming language?
explanation: Java language was developed by Sun Microsystems in 1991.

text: Easy: What is the full form of E-Commerce?
explanation: E-commerce can also be defined as buying and selling of products, services and information using electronic media like Internet.

text: An array in Java is a collection of which type of elements?
explanation: An array is a variable representing a collection of homogeneous type of elements.

text: In the statement 'Room r1 = new Room();', what specific task does the 'new' keyword perform?
choices: It allocates memory for the object on the heap.
explanation: The keyword 'new' is used to create the object by allocating memory. Operator new allocates the memory for an object and returns the address.

text: Java is a ______ programming language.
explanation: Java follows the object-oriented programming paradigm.

text: What is the full form of 'GSWAN'?
explanation: According to the handwritten notes (item 20), GSWAN stands for Gujarat State Wide Area Network.

text: What is the primary purpose of an HTML form on a web page?
choices: To collect user input and send it to a server
To format the layout of the page
explanation: A form in HTML is a container used to collect different kinds of inputs from the user... used to setup the account... or register on a website.

text: In the Object-Oriented paradigm, what is the focus compared to procedural programming?
explanation: In the object-oriented paradigm, the focus is on objects which contain both data and functionality together.

text: Easy: What is the first step in planning a website?
explanation: The purpose of the website should be clearly identified. Developing a good website is a project similar to any other project and requires detailed planning.

text: Easy: What does M-Commerce stand for?
explanation: Mobile Commerce also known as M-commerce. It refers to buying and selling of goods or services through the use of Internet enabled wireless devices.

text: What does CSS stand for in web development?
explanation: Cascading Style Sheets or CSS allows you to specify styles for the visual elements of the website.

text: What is the machine language for the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) called?
explanation: The machine language for the Java Virtual Machine is called Java bytecode.

text: Medium: Which website is cited as a prime example of an online bookstore in the text?
explanation: Amazon.com... a good website displaying all the books category wise... online bookstores may also record the customer's interests.

text: A 1-D data structure is often referred to as a:
explanation: Vector is a one dimensional (1-D) data structure that can be used to store list of items like characters, numbers.

text: What is the specific compilation error or result if a static method tries to access an instance variable directly?
choices: It compiles but throws a runtime error.
It creates a new instance automatically.
It causes a compilation error because instance variables belong to objects.
It treats the instance variable as a local variable.
explanation: Instance variables cannot be accessed from class methods (static methods) because class methods are global to the class itself and do not belong to any object.

text: A class in Java contains:
explanation: A class contains both data members (variables) and methods.

text: What does 'WYSIWYG' stand for?
choices: What You See Is What You Get
Where You See Is Where You Go
Why You See Is What You Get
What You Saw Is What You Got
explanation: Item 6 in the notes defines WYSIWYG as 'what you see is what you get'.

text: Which attribute of the `<form>` tag specifies the HTTP method used to send data?
explanation: The method attribute specifies the HTTP method to be used when sending the data.

text: Which term describes a template for multiple objects with similar features?
explanation: A class is a template for multiple objects with similar features. It describes a group of objects with similar attributes and common behavior.

text: Medium: In the Table Properties dialog box in KompoZer, what does 'Spacing' control?
choices: The space between the table and the text
The space between content and cell borders
explanation: Spacing is used to specify gap between cells. Padding gives a gap between the edge of the cell and the text within it.

text: Easy: Which of the following is a key advantage of M-Commerce mentioned in the text?
explanation: M-commerce provides the user with the advantage of flexibility and ubiquity.

text: In the CSS syntax `H1 { color : green }`, what is `H1` called?
explanation: The selector is the HTML element on which you want to apply the style. In the example `H1 { color : green }`, H1 is the selector.

text: Which command is used to compile a Java source file?
explanation: To compile the Java program, type 'javac' followed by the name of your source file.

text: Hard: In the context of Online Auctions, what happens when the time limit for a bid is reached?
choices: The item is removed from the site.
The item is transferred to the highest bidder.
explanation: By placing goods for auction... or the time limit is over, the item is transferred to the bidder.

text: What is the correct syntax to declare and create an integer array of size 5?
explanation: The syntax to declare array is: <data type> <array name>[]; ... Example: int marks[] = new int[5];.

text: When are 'Class Variables' (static variables) initialized?
choices: Every time a new object is created.
Only when the programmer explicitly initializes them.
When the class is loaded, with default values.
explanation: Class variables are initialized with default values. They are defined within a class with the static keyword and memory is allocated only once per class.

text: Which keyword is used to define a class in Java?
explanation: The 'class' keyword is used to define a class in Java.

text: In the context of the notes, what is 'IDE'?
explanation: Item 4 defines IDE as 'Integrated development Environment'.

text: What is the default value for the `method` attribute if it is not specified?
explanation: The default value for method attribute is GET.

text: In a UML Class diagram, what does the top section contain?
explanation: In a class diagram, a class is represented with a rectangle split into three sections. The top section contains the Name of the class.

text: Hard: When inserting an image in KompoZer, why is the 'Alternate text' field important?
choices: It displays text if the image cannot be loaded
It links the image to another page
explanation: Specify the alternate text in the input box otherwise select the 'Don't use alternate text' radio button. Giving alternate text will display the text in case the image is not displayed.

text: Medium: Which of the following is listed as a limitation of M-Commerce?
choices: Limited screen size of handheld devices
explanation: The handheld devices commonly used today offer a limited screen size... This further limits the types of file and data transfer.

text: Which menu in KompoZer contains the 'Preferences' option to enable CSS?
explanation: To make sure that KompoZer uses CSS by default, click Edit -> Preferences.

text: What is the file extension of a compiled Java bytecode file?
explanation: When the program gets compiled without errors, the compiler creates a file with extension .class.

text: Easy: Which HTML tag is used to embed JavaScript into a web page?
explanation: The <script> tag tells the browser to interpret all the text between the <script> tag as a script.

text: If an `int` takes 4 bytes, how much memory does `int marks[5]` occupy?
explanation: Integer of int data type uses 4 bytes storage space. Thus, array 'marks' requires 5 x 4 = 20 bytes in contiguous locations.

text: If `Room r1;` is executed but not initialized, what happens if you try to access `r1.length`?
choices: It raises a runtime exception (error) because r1 is null.
explanation: Referring to an instance variable or invoking a method with a null reference will give an error. Variable r1 contains null by default if not initialized.

text: An object is created in Java using which keyword?
explanation: The 'new' keyword allocates memory for an object.

text: What is the full form of 'IRCTC'?
choices: Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd
explanation: Item 23 lists IRCTC as 'Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corporation Ltd'.

text: Which HTTP method sends form data as part of the URL?
explanation: The GET method retrieves the data from the form and sends it to the server by attaching it at the end of the URL.

text: Which concept protects data from unintended actions by wrapping data and methods into a single unit?
explanation: Encapsulation provides protection to data and methods. It wraps them into a single unit known as a class and keeps data safe from unintended actions.

text: Easy: Which menu is used to insert a table in KompoZer?
explanation: Go to Insert -> Table. Select single cell table and press OK button.

text: Hard: Which application of M-Commerce allows companies to provide location-based ads to users?
explanation: Mobile Marketing and Advertising... offers location based mobile advertising in order to target consumers... based on the location of the user.

text: What is the primary advantage of using CSS?
choices: It is required for saving files.
explanation: Thus we can say that, HTML is used to describe the information content... and not the style, while CSS describes the style... It separates design from implementation.

text: Which character is used to start a single-line comment in Java?
explanation: A single-line comment begins with double slashes (//) and extends till the end of a line.

text: Medium: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of E-Commerce?
explanation: Privacy and Security are typically listed as disadvantages or challenges, whereas cost, reach, and speed are advantages.

text: In Java, array indexing starts from:
explanation: Index specifies the position of an element in an array; for example, marks[2]. Index value starts from 0.

text: Which of the following constitutes a valid 'Method Signature' for overloading?
choices: Method name and list of parameters (types/sequence)
explanation: The method's signature is a combination of the method name and the list of parameters. The return type is not part of the signature for overloading purposes.

text: Variables defined inside a class but outside methods are called:
explanation: Instance variables are declared inside a class but outside methods.

text: What does 'BOM' stand for?
explanation: Item 8 defines BOM as 'Browser Object Model'.

text: Which HTTP method sends data as a block within the HTTP transaction, keeping it hidden from the URL?
explanation: In the POST method, the data is sent as a block through the HTTP transaction.

text: What does the empty diamond symbol represent in a class diagram?
explanation: Aggregation is represented using an empty diamond symbol next to the whole class.

text: Medium: Which tab in the Image Properties dialog allows you to change the height and width of an image?
explanation: The Image Properties dialog box (Figure 3.7) shows tabs: Location, Dimensions, Appearance, Link. Dimensions is used for Actual Size/Custom Size.

text: Easy: Which HTML tag is used to define a multi-line text input control?
explanation: The Textarea element allows multi-line text input. The tag <textarea>... is used to implement this element.

text: In the CSS syntax, which symbol separates the Property from the Value?
explanation: Declaration consists of a property associated with the HTML element used in selector and its corresponding value. The general syntax is `property : value` (separated by a colon).

text: What is the default data type for floating-point literals in Java?
explanation: In Java, floating point literal by default is of the type double.

text: Hard: In KompoZer's 'Link Properties' dialog, checking the box 'URL is relative to page location' ensures what?
choices: The link opens in a new window.
The site remains portable when moved to another directory.
The link points to an email address.
explanation: Checking 'URL is relative to page location' stores the path relative to the file, which is crucial for site portability.

text: Which values are array elements initialized with by default upon creation?
explanation: As array is an object, so its elements are initialized with default values.

text: In the memory model, where are 'Instance Variables' stored?
choices: In the Heap area where the object lives
explanation: Memory is allocated from the heap area to store the value of its attributes. Thus every object has its own instance variables occupying different space in memory.

text: Memory for objects in Java is allocated in:
explanation: Objects are allocated memory in the heap area.

text: What is the full form of 'NPCI'?
explanation: Item 31 defines NPCI as 'National Payment Corporation of India'.

text: What does the `action` attribute in the `<form>` tag specify?
choices: The filename/URL where data is sent
explanation: The action attribute is used to specify where to send the form data when the form is submitted. It takes a filename as value.

text: Which feature allows different methods to have the same name but different signatures?
explanation: Object-oriented programming allows defining more than one method having the same name but different signatures. This feature is known as function or method overloading.

text: Hard: In the CSS Stylesheets dialog, if you want to apply a specific style only to `<h1>` tags, which option under 'New Style rule' should be selected?
choices: style applied to all elements of class
style applied to an element with specified ID
style applied to all elements of type
explanation: Click on the first radio button 'style applied to all elements of type'. In the drop down menu choose an element... h1.

text: Medium: In Java, what is the correct syntax to get the length of an array named `marks`?
explanation: With array variable, length is an attribute or property of array... so we use `marks.length` (without parenthesis).

text: Which button in the KompoZer Composition toolbar is used to open the CSS Stylesheets dialog box?
explanation: In the composition toolbar, select the Cascade button. This will open the CSS Stylesheets dialog box.

text: Which prefix is used to represent a hexadecimal integer literal in Java?
explanation: In Java, a hexadecimal literal begins with 0x or 0X.

text: Easy: Which website is mentioned as an example of an 'Electronic Newspaper'?
explanation: Figure 4.2 shows the home page of E-newspaper Washington Post.

text: How do you initialize an array with specific values like 90, 70, 77 without using 'new'?
explanation: 1-D array is initialized using comma separated values of data elements in braces { }. For example, int marks[] = {90, 70, 77};.

text: What is the associativity of the dot (.) operator in Java?
explanation: The dot (.) is an operator and associativity of the dot operator is from left to right.

text: Which method is automatically called when an object is created?
explanation: Constructors are automatically invoked when an object is created.

text: What does 'JDK' stand for?
explanation: Item 33 lists JDK as 'Java Development Kit'.

text: Which tag is used to create a multi-line text input field?
explanation: The Textarea element allows multi-line text input. The tag <textarea>...</textarea> is used to implement this element.

text: In inheritance, what is the relationship between a subclass and a superclass generally referred to as?
explanation: Inheritance is generally referred to as an 'is-a-kind-of' relationship between two classes.

text: Medium: What is the purpose of the 'Medium' phase in website planning?
choices: To select the software to write code
To determine computer and smartphone compatibility
explanation: More and more people are using Internet through smart phones and tablets. The website design should scale for all the devices... (This falls under the Medium section).

text: Hard: Which security issue is specifically mentioned as a limitation of M-Commerce?
choices: Wireless networks are less secured compared to wired networks
explanation: It operates over wireless networks which are less secured as compared to wired network.

text: Which tab in the CSS Stylesheets dialog allows you to change the Font Family and Font Size?
explanation: The Text tab is shown in figure 2.5... In the Font family section... Font size....

text: Which escape sequence represents a 'Tab' in Java?
explanation: The escape code \t represents a Tab.

text: Medium: What specific service allows customers to view bills and pay them online?
explanation: In online billing, companies send their bills to customers through E-mail... Companies who need to send the bills to a large number of customers.

text: If you try to access an element outside the array bounds, what happens?
explanation: If we try to access the elements of an array (outside its size), it will result in an error.

text: Which step of creating an object involves the 'special method' called a constructor?
explanation: Initialization: Constructor (a special type of method) is called to initialize the newly created object.

text: Instance variables are initialized with:
explanation: Instance variables get default values automatically.

text: What does 'JVM' stand for?
explanation: Item 35 defines JVM as 'Java Virtual Machine'.

text: Which input type creates a field where characters are masked (e.g., as dots)?
explanation: Password: Creates a password field... the characters are not displayed to the user... converted into non readable format.

text: What does the filled diamond symbol represent in a relationship between classes?
explanation: Composition relationships are represented using a filled diamond symbol next to the whole class.

text: Hard: In JavaScript, what does `document.js1.name.value` access?
choices: The value of the 'name' field in the 'js1' form
The value of the 'js1' field in the 'name' form
The CSS style of the name field
explanation: The term `js1` refers to the form name; `name` refers to the element name (the input field). `value` gets the content.

text: Easy: Which website is used as an example for 'Mobile Ticketing' in the text?
choices: IRCTC (Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation)
explanation: Figure 5.1 shows the Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation limited (IRCTC) login page.

text: To apply a style to all `<h1>` elements on a page, which option should be selected in the 'New Style Rule' section?
choices: style applied to all elements of class
style applied to an element with specified ID
style applied to all elements of type
explanation: Click on the first radio button 'style applied to all elements of type' (selector: h1).

text: What is the output of the expression 12.5 % 7.2?
explanation: In the case of a % b where a=12.5 and b=7.2, the integer quotient is 1 and the remainder is 5.3.

text: Hard: Which Java class provides methods like `sort()` and `fill()` for array manipulation?
explanation: All methods of class Arrays can be used with array objects. Examples of such methods are: sort, fill.

text: Which class provides useful static methods like `sort()` and `fill()` for arrays?
explanation: Java.util.Arrays class... enables us to make use of methods of Arrays class with array type of data... such as sort() and fill().

text: If `totWindows` is a static variable in class `Room`, how should it ideally be accessed from another class?
explanation: Class variables can be accessed using `<classname>.<class variable>`. For example: `Room.totWindows`.

text: Which variable is shared by all objects of a class?
explanation: Static variables are shared among all objects of a class.

text: What is the full form of 'ASCII'?
choices: American Standard Code for Information Interchange
Asian Standard Code for Internet Interchange
American System Code for Information Input
explanation: Item 51 defines ASCII as 'American Standard Code for Information Interchange'.

text: If you want a user to select only one option from a group, which input type should be used?
explanation: Radio: Creates radio buttons... Generally used to select a single item from a given group of items.

text: In UML notation, which symbol represents 'private' visibility?
explanation: In UML, visibility can be private, protected, public or package, represented using symbols -, #, + and ~ respectively.

text: Easy: Which symbol is used to enclose a JavaScript block?
explanation: JavaScript statements can be grouped together in a block. A block starts and ends with the curly bracket { }.

text: Medium: What does the JavaScript function `isNaN(x)` return if `x` is the string "123"?
explanation: `isNaN(123)` returns false as the value "123" is a number (JavaScript coerces the string).

text: Which tab would you use to set a background image for an element?
explanation: To set the background color, select the Background tab... Note: If you want to keep an image in the background then in the Image option, click on 'Choose file'.

text: Which routine is the first to run when a Java application is executed?
explanation: In Java applications, main() is the first routine that is run when the program is executed.
